products.name: Moly
products.tagline: Better thinking before you hit send.
products.description: A Socratic communication coach. Moly asks the one question that matters, then helps you write. It never decides for you. Private by design: your conversations stay on your computer, with a model on your computer (Ollama) or your own Claude or OpenAI key. No account, no analytics.

products.name: Socrates
products.tagline: A conversation with artificial Greek philosophers.
products.description: Socrates, Diogenes, Plato and Aristotle, each revived in today's world and speaking as himself. They ask hard questions, do not give verdicts, and remember what you told them, in your own words, which you can see and delete. Runs on your own AI provider key, with no server of ours.

research.text: Socrates (proof of concept): a Python multi-agent platform that clarifies a project before it is built
